steps.en: OCMS detects a PLUS request that fails the conditions
steps.id: OCMS mendeteksi request PLUS yang tidak memenuhi kondisi
steps.why_en: No mention outcome request or check exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada request atau pemeriksaan hasil mention.

steps.en: OCMS sends PLUS an error message so the user knows it failed
steps.id: OCMS mengirim pesan error ke PLUS agar user tahu gagal
steps.why_en: Error replies exist only for other PLUS requests, not outcomes.
steps.why_id: Balasan error hanya ada untuk request PLUS lain, bukan hasil mention.
